schema:alternativeHeadline: Scan page 15 of Magpie. Muscular bare-chested person poses in a short towel or trunks. Map locates the Tonky Honker at 14536 Arminta on the south side of Arminta Street, west of Van Nuys Boulevard and east of the San Diego Freeway.
